issues.description: Farm.singFarmSongVerse is specified to take an Animal parameter (UML: singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal)), but the template defines singFarmSongVerse with the Animal parameter commented out (private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)). Students following the template literally may implement a parameterless helper method that does not match the intended design/signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template signature to `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` (uncomment the parameter) so it matches the UML/spec and the reference solution.

issues.description: The UML specifies Farm.singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal) as private, but the solution implements it as protected (`protected void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)`). This creates uncertainty about the required access modifier and may lead students to implement a different visibility than expected by the specification/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution method to `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` to match the UML, or update the UML/problem statement to specify `protected` if that visibility is intended.
